title: Global Toxic Air
description: Makes the surface air extremely toxic, it will exponentially deal more and more damage to all non-undead mobs exposed to the sky.
body:
# What this mod does
This mod features a highly complex toxicity system that causes the world to become flooded with invisible odorless toxic air, this air will flood even newly made caves and will fill even new bases, the onlly way to remove it being ~~pumping it out~~(Not Implemented Yet)

## Mod Status
Current in development. The mod is open for public review but lacks the nessesary additions for survival. Please feel free to test the mod and try identify any bugs.
